summary: Feed s069_single to SIEM is degraded due to 19.0% duplicate packets (679/3573) exceeding 5% threshold. All other visibility checks (encrypted_share, missing_vlan, one_way, oversize, packet_drops, tool_overload, truncated, tunnel) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Overlapping SPAN/mirror sessions or dual TAP feeds aggregated in packet broker without deduplication - same packet arrives via two paths and is forwarded twice to the SIEM tool port.
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM will ingest duplicate events, inflating EPS, license and storage usage, creating duplicate alerts and skewed correlation/reporting and reducing retention. Detection still works but with significant noise and cost overhead.

recommended_fix.why: Enable packet-broker deduplication with ~1ms window to drop duplicate copies before delivery to SIEM, removing 19% waste while preserving all unique traffic.
